event.name: SC_BOARDER_MARINE
event.text: Enemy assault team approaching!

event.name: SC_BOARDER_FIRE
event.text: Need a light?

event.name: SC_BOARDER_GHOST
event.text: A team of specialists has been sent to collect the bounty on your head.

event.name: SC_TEST
event.text: Oh no enemies!

event.name: SC_TEST2
event.text: Oh no enemies!

choice.text: Send in a specialist to handle it.

event.name: EVENT_TERRAN_WRAITH
event.text: Aaaaa! Scary ship!

event.name: SC_SURRENDER_TERRAN
event.text: "Stand down. We can transfer supplies if you let us limp out of here."

event.name: SC_SURRENDER_TERRAN_SCOUT
event.text: "You recieve a jumbled message from the heavily damaged ship. The remaining crew has surrendered and is requesting immediate aid."

event.name: SC_SURRENDER_TERRAN_TRANSPORT
event.text: "Fine, fine. Take the cargo. Just do not vent us into space."

event.name: SC_SURRENDER_PROTOSS
event.text: The Protoss commander transmits a terse offer of withdrawal. Their vessel remains dangerous, but they seem willing to leave.

event.name: SC_SURRENDER_DOMINION_ELITE
event.text: "You have made your point. We are authorized to offer battlefield salvage for safe passage."

event.name: SC_DESTROYED_TERRAN
event.text: The Terran patrol ship breaks apart. You salvage what remains.

event.name: SC_DEAD_CREW_TERRAN
event.text: With the crew neutralized, you search the Terran vessel and secure its supplies.

event.name: SC_DESTROYED_RAIDER
event.text: The raider ship is destroyed. Whatever cargo survived is now yours.

event.name: SC_DEAD_CREW_RAIDER
event.text: The raiders are gone. Their hold is easy to search now.

event.name: SC_DESTROYED_ZERG
event.text: The swarm vessel ruptures, leaving behind only scorched biological residue and a few salvageable fragments.

event.name: SC_DEAD_CREW_ZERG
event.text: The infestation is quiet. Your crew carefully collects what can be salvaged.

event.name: SC_DESTROYED_INFESTED
event.text: The infested ship collapses in a cloud of spores. You keep your distance and recover whatever drifts clear.

event.name: SC_DEAD_CREW_INFESTED
event.text: The last infested life-sign fades. The ship is dangerous to board, but some supplies are intact.

event.name: SC_DESTROYED_PROTOSS
event.text: The Protoss ship fractures under your fire. Its strange components are difficult to repurpose, but valuable.

event.name: SC_DEAD_CREW_PROTOSS
event.text: The Protoss vessel falls silent. You recover advanced components from the ship.

event.name: SC_DESTROYED_DOMINION_ELITE
event.text: The Dominion elite ship is destroyed. Its reinforced hull leaves useful salvage behind.

event.name: SC_DEAD_CREW_DOMINION_ELITE
event.text: With the Dominion crew defeated, you seize their equipment and encrypted supply manifest.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL
event.text: Your ship arrives near the edge of a Terran patrol route. Sensor shadows flicker between nearby debris fields.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_DETECT_SUCCESS_1
event.text: Your sensors catch a faint Terran patrol signature before they fully lock onto you. You have a narrow chance to act first.

choice.text: Avoid the patrol and move on.

event.text: You alter course and slip away before the patrol can confirm your position.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_DETECT_SUCCESS_2
event.text: Your improved sensors identify the patrol route before they spot you. You can choose the terms of engagement.

choice.text: Avoid the patrol and move on.

event.text: You skirt the edge of their patrol route and continue undetected.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_DETECT_SUCCESS_3
event.text: Your advanced sensors resolve the patrol's course, weapon profile, and blind spots before they notice you.

choice.text: Ambush the patrol from their blind spot.
Avoid the patrol and move on.

event.text: You pass cleanly through a gap in their sweep pattern.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_DETECT_SUCCESS_4
event.text: Your sensor suite maps the patrol in detail before they have any chance of seeing you. Their formation, course, and weak points are all exposed.
With complete knowledge of their patrol pattern, you leave the area without ever appearing on their scopes.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_AMBUSH
event.text: Your sensors resolve the patrol's course before they notice you. You maneuver into position and spring the attack.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_DETECT_FAIL
event.text: The patrol detects you first. A Terran vessel turns toward your position, weapons charging as it moves to intercept.

choice.text: (High Evasion) Push the engines and attempt to outrun the patrol.
(Cloaking) Attempt to avoid the patrol under cloak.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_EVADE_SUCCESS
event.text: You divert power to evasive maneuvers and break away before the patrol can establish a firing solution.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_EVADE_FAILURE
event.text: You push the engines hard, but the patrol anticipates your course and cuts off your escape.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_CLOAK_SUCCESS
event.text: You cloak and drift beyond the patrol's search pattern. By the time your signature returns, the Terran ship is scanning the wrong part of the beacon.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_CLOAK_FAILURE
event.text: You cloak, but the patrol has already narrowed your position. They spread their search pattern and catch you as your cloak begins to fade.

event.name: SC_TERRAN_PATROL_FIGHT
event.text: The patrol closes in before you can escape. You power your weapons and prepare for battle.
